title: BPSC Scraps Sep 22-27 TRE-4.0 Exam Window, Reopens Registration Under New Advertisement
detail: The Bihar Public Service Commission cancels its Advertisement No. 14/2026 for Teacher Recruitment Examination 4.0 — under which the single-stage written exam had been scheduled for Sep 22-27 — and replaces it with Advertisement No. 15/2026, dated Sep 22, 2026. The new notification keeps the headline vacancy count at 32,388 posts across Classes 1-12 but reopens the online application window from Sep 25 to Oct 26, 2026, with no new written-exam date announced; multiple outlets report the exam is now not expected until December 2026 or January 2027. The reversal extends a recruitment saga that has already seen TRE-4 postponed once (Aug 31) after the Aug 18 notification, pushing the process roughly four months past its original Sep 2026 timeline.

media.caption: BPSC reopens TRE-4.0 registration under Advt 15/2026 after scrapping the Sep 22-27 exam window.
